## Intent

Which user request and outcome does this PR address, and what is deliberately out of scope?

## Testing

Exact commands, candidate SHA, observed results, skipped checks and missing live-client/platform evidence.

## Risk

Low / Medium / High, with failure modes, routing/permissions/contracts affected, blast radius and reversibility.

## How to revert

Feature flag, commit revert, rollback or forward recovery, owner, and constraints.

## Reviewer context

Relevant `AGENTS.md` / `REVIEW.md` rules, sensitive paths, routing/evaluation updates, pre-existing failures and open findings. An AI finding is not human sign-off.
